user.title: Set up Posten Bring
user.description: Choose which brand's login page to use. Either brand's account works for tracking parcels in Norway, Sweden and Denmark alike — this only picks which login page opens next. Do not add this integration a second time with the other brand for the same account: both read the same inbox, so you'd see every parcel twice.

login.title: Sign in to {brand}

reauth_confirm.title: Posten Bring sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description:
Posten Bring no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Open this URL, sign in again, and paste the redirect URL below (see [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url}) if you're not sure how to find it):

{authorize_url}

error.invalid_redirect: That doesn't look like a valid redirect URL — make sure you copied the complete address, including the code and state parameters.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Posten Bring. Please try again.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, raw event text). Off by default.
